classification.summary: VaultCore.mintMultiple() skipped the supported-asset check that mint() performed, so the attacker passed a self-controlled fake stablecoin whose transferFrom re-entered the vault and triggered a rebase between the first mint's asset transfer and its OUSD supply increase, minting more OUSD than the vault held in assets.

sources.note: onchain review: the vault in force at the incident is 0x277e80f3 (OUSD token 0x2a8e1e67.vaultAddress() at block 11272254); the vault redeployed after the hack (0xe75d77b1) postdates the incident and would fail measurement. VaultProxy 0x277e80f3 created 2020-09-18 by 0xaed9fdc9681d61edb5f8b8e421f5cee8d7f4b04f, not by attack sender 0xb77f7bba; 11 EIP-1967 upgrades before the incident, the last on 2020-11-13 - only 3.7 days before - consistent with Origin's statement that the missing validation was introduced by a gas-saving refactor. lossUsd 7,000,000 per Origin's own disclosure and CoinDesk; rekt's leaderboard lists $8m
